caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Are you ready? Let's go!

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Verse 1]
Who's got a mane and a great big roar?
Rory the lion, stomping on the floor!
Roar, roar, stomp, stomp, one, two, three,
Rory says hello, can you roar with me?

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Verse 2]
Who's got whiskers and a jingly bell?
Ziggy the kitten, she can dance so well!
Meow, meow, twirl around, one, two, three,
Ziggy says hello, can you twirl with me?

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Verse 3]
Who's got floppy ears and a waggy tail?
Waffles the puppy, jumping without fail!
Woof, woof, jump jump, one, two, three,
Waffles says hello, can you jump with me?

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Verse 4]
Who's got a scarf and a waddle so small?
Pebble the penguin, the littlest of all!
Flap, flap, waddle waddle, one, two, three,
Pebble says hello, can you waddle with me?

[Bridge]
Now everybody, roar! Roar!
Now everybody, twirl! Twirl!
Now everybody, jump! Jump!
Now everybody, waddle, waddle, waddle!

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!

[Outro]
Bye bye, friends! See you next time!
